sourceText:
Orange Poppy Seed Muffins
By: Cresent
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




2 cups JIFFY Baking Mix
1/2 cup Sugar
1 tablespoon Poppy Seeds
3 tablespoons Instant Vanilla Pudding (dry)
1 tablespoon Orange Peel
2 teaspoons Baking Powder
1 Egg
1/2 cup Buttermilk
1/2 cup Fresh Orange Juice
1/4 cup Cooking Oil

Preparation

1 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Grease muffin tin or use paper liners. 2 2. In a bowl, mix well and set aside Baking Mix, sugar, poppy seeds, pudding, orange peel and baking powder. 3 3. Mix until well blended, egg, buttermilk, orange juice, and oil. 4 4. Fold into dry ingredients. 5 5. Bake 18 - 20 minutes in greased muffin tin(s). 6 Yield: 12 Large Muffins)

Comments:
Cresent

A recipe that starts with Jiffy mix? Wow.
